structured.reason: The description contains minimizing and hedging language that the criterion treats as negative. (1) "the secure cap helps reduce spills" minimizes a complaint the reviews raise directly (one reviewer "managed to spill the liquid twice," and another says the bottles "always leaked"). "Reduce" implies the spill problem still exists to some degree. (2) "is designed to last up to 10 hours" is a qualified claim; "up to" hedges the performance statement rather than stating a pure positive. The rest of the description is positive or neutral specs, but these phrases are enough to fail under the strict standard.
